App ka design kaise plan karun?

Ek screen se shuru karein

Pehle Home aur Chat ka basic flow decide karein. User ko naya chat shuru karna aur purana chat kholna aasaan hona chahiye.

Chat mein header, messages aur composer ki jagah consistent rakhein. Messages badhne par sirf conversation scroll ho.

Har reply ki state banayein

Loading, complete reply, error, quota limit aur internet disconnect ke liye clear messages rakhein.

Send ke baad input clear karein. Reply generate hote waqt Stop control dikhayein. Response complete hone par normal composer controls wapas laayein.

Keyboard aur chhoti screen check karein

Keyboard khulne par composer uske upar rahe. Latest message tak pahunchne ke liye ek simple shortcut dein.

Buttons ke touch areas kam se kam 48 × 48 rakhein aur text ko readable spacing dein.

Web aur Android same rakhna hai.

Haan, dono mein same colors, typography, icons aur screen states use karein.

Platform ke keyboard aur system navigation ke hisaab se layout adjust karein.
